# Narido SRL

Narido SRL is an IT company in Ottignies-Louvain-la-Neuve, Belgium. It leads the technical work on products that have to hold up, from payments platforms through cloud moves and on to release. AI sits in that same work.

More than 20 years of hands-on work, across payments and fintech, cloud migration, DevOps, quality engineering, delivery, and AI adoption.

## Services

- AI adoption for product and development teams. AI inside the products, and inside the way a team builds them. Features that make the product smarter, and tools that make the team faster, with people reviewing every output.
- Tech lead / fractional CTO. Architecture, priorities, code review, and the decisions that are easy to postpone. When a team is blocked, Narido writes the code.
- Cloud & DevOps. Systems move to the cloud with the pipelines and environments left in place.
- Quality & delivery. The distance between a change and production gets shorter, with releases small enough that a problem is easy to find.

## Selected work

- Genius Formers Coach: https://www.geniusformers.com/en/coach
  A coach sends a short questionnaire, adds a few keywords, and gets a full guidance report in about four minutes.
- Genius Formers Team: https://www.geniusformers.com/en/team
  After a group training, each participant gets a private space with an Enneagram report, an AI helper, and practice scenarios.
- Health Detective: https://healthdetective.ai
  An AI that assembles a patient's medical history from documents that arrive in pieces. Built for clinics in Europe.
- Lumilaw: https://lumilaw.com
  Development of custom Drupal modules.
